name: unifi-network-application
description: The Unifi-network-application(https://ui.com/) software is a powerful, enterprise wireless software engine ideal for high-density client deployments requiring low latency and high uptime performance.

ports.name: Port: 1900
ports.description: Required for `Make controller discoverable on L2 network` option

ports.name: Port: 8843
ports.description: Unifi guest portal HTTPS redirect port

ports.name: Port: 8880
ports.description: Unifi guest portal HTTP redirect port

variables.name: MONGO_USER
variables.description: Mongodb Username. Only evaluated on first run. **Special characters must be url encoded(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Percent-encoding)**.

variables.name: MONGO_PASS
variables.description: Mongodb Password. Only evaluated on first run. **Special characters must be url encoded(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Percent-encoding)**.

variables.name: MONGO_HOST
variables.description: Mongodb Hostname. Only evaluated on first run.

variables.name: MONGO_PORT
variables.description: Mongodb Port. Only evaluated on first run.

variables.name: MONGO_DBNAME
variables.description: Mongodb Database Name (stats DB is automatically suffixed with `_stat`). Only evaluated on first run.

variables.name: MONGO_AUTHSOURCE
variables.description: Mongodb authSource(https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/connection-string/#mongodb-urioption-urioption.authSource). For Atlas set to `admin`. Only evaluated on first run.

variables.name: MEM_LIMIT
variables.description: Optionally change the Java memory limit (in Megabytes). Set to `default` to reset to default

variables.name: MEM_STARTUP
variables.description: Optionally change the Java initial/minimum memory (in Megabytes). Set to `default` to reset to default

variables.name: MONGO_TLS
variables.description: Mongodb enable TLS(https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/connection-string/#mongodb-urioption-urioption.tls). Only evaluated on first run.
